title: Uniform $L^p$ expression
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a real number $p$, and a real-valued function $f$ on $\Omega$, define $\|f\|_{p,u}=\left(\frac{1}{|\Omega|}\sum_{x\in\Omega}|f(x)|^p\right)^{1/p}$, with real powers understood as real powers.
